title: When a saved view and a page-link range clash the saved view wins
preconds:
1. You have a saved view with a known date range (for example Last Month).
2. You have a page link carrying a DIFFERENT date range (for example This Year), captured earlier..
steps:
1. Open the report using the link with the different range.
2. Read the date range picker.
expected:
1. The saved view is applied (Last Month) and the link value is ignored.
2. This is intentional: a shared link restores the sender's range only for a recipient who has no saved range of their own.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S2-R9), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.
